claim.text: One of the brave service members who helped achieve this stunning turnaround was 20-year-old West Virginia Army National Guard Specialist, Sarah Beckstrom.

evidence.snippet: [2026-02-24] Official Congressional Record (State of the Union transcript) quoting that Beckstrom was 20, extended deployment, and 'her rank was going to be lifted'.
[2025-12-11] Confirms 20yo Spc. Sarah Beckstrom, WV ARNG MP, DC deployment Aug 2025, honors/voluntary service.
[2025-12-12] West Virginia National Guard official article confirming Beckstrom’s age, rank (Spc.), unit, DC mobilization, and service details.
[2025-12-11] Official bio: enlisted post-grad, Fort Leonard Wood training, Aug DC mobilization, quiet professional dedication.
[2025-11-27] Obit details: 20yo, WV ARNG 863rd MP, Aug deployment to DC Op Safe & Beautiful, volunteered Nov/Dec extension.
[2025-12-09] Senate resolution honoring Beckstrom states she was 20 and that she and Wolfe had volunteered to extend their deployments.
[2025-11-27] Confirms Spc. Beckstrom, 20, Summersville WV, enlisted 2023, MP in DC for safety operation, killed on duty.
[2025-12-04] Presidential proclamation honoring Spc. Sarah Beckstrom, WV ARNG, flags at half-staff.
[2025-11-28] New York Times report naming Specialist Sarah Beckstrom (20) as the West Virginia Guardsman shot in the November D.C. ambush.
[2025-12-23] Details ambush killing of Spc. Beckstrom while on patrol with WV NG in DC Nov 2025.
